summary: Iteration 7 verified the subscription auth-gate back-button fix (user's actual complaint, 2nd report). RUN 1 (12/12 PASS, 375x667 mobile viewport, public preview URL): fresh /onboarding starts at splash; completed full onboarding (Welcome -> referral-skip -> all 20 questions: name/goals/selfDesc filled, Female/Single/It's fine for now/No selected, rest skipped) -> 'Generate My Profile' -> ~9s Generating -> auto-landed on /subscription?from=onboarding showing AuthGateStep ('Create Account or Sign In'). CORE REGRESSION R1 PASS: auth-gate top-left back arrow -> /onboarding resumes at the PAYWALL screen 25 ('Unlock Your Full Potential' + 'View My Plan Options' visible, splash 'tap anywhere to begin' NOT visible, question 1 NOT shown) - the reported bug is FIXED. R3 PASS: paywall 'View My Plan Options' -> back to /subscription?from=onboarding auth gate (no crash, no splash loop). R2 PASS: entered delivered@resend.dev on the gate -> OTP stage ('Check Your Email') -> back arrow -> returns to email stage (existing behavior preserved). R4 PASS (iteration_6 regression): Welcome step 2 'Log in' -> /login ('Welcome Back') -> new top-left back arrow (aria-label 'Go back', login.tsx:358-369) -> returns to /onboarding at the Welcome step, NOT splash. A3 PASS: full reload of /onboarding starts at splash (module state resets on reload - expected on web). RUN 2 (4/4 PASS): logged in as delivered@resend.dev via UI OTP (code forced to 1234 via mongo code_hash override per /app/memory/test_credentials.md; note OTP is 4 digits, the UI maxLength=4) -> profile tab -> Settings 'Reset Journey' -> confirm 'Reset' -> lands on /onboarding at SPLASH step 1 (resetOnboardingProgress wired, profile.tsx:472/505), NOT resumed at paywall or question 1. No page errors in any run.

react_native_issues.component: Carryover from iterations 4-6 (not re-verified this run, no new instances introduced)
react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated style props (shadow*/textShadow*), props.pointerEvents on splash (onboarding.tsx:376), Animated useNativeDriver fallback on web, iapService.web.ts require cycle, expo-notifications push listener on web. See iteration_6.json for full detail.

action_items: Optional hygiene (carryover): onboarding.tsx is 1159 lines (>700 guideline) - split screens into components.
Optional: add testID attributes to back arrows / CTA buttons / inputs (auth-gate and onboarding back arrows are icon-only Pressables reachable only via coordinates (42,30)/(42,66) in automation).
Optional: clean up RN-on-web deprecation warnings carried over from iterations 4-6.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct and minimal: onboarding.tsx:684-702 persistAndNavigate('/subscription') sets setLastOnboardingScreen(25) BEFORE router.replace({pathname:'/subscription', params:{from:'onboarding'}}) - both provably executed at runtime (URL carried from=onboarding; back returned to paywall screen 25).

subscription.tsx:569-579 AuthGateStep back handler ordering is correct: otp stage -> email stage (verified preserved), else from==='onboarding' -> router.replace('/onboarding') (resumes paywall via getLastOnboardingScreen() at onboarding.tsx:551), else router.back().

Fresh-start entries all call resetOnboardingProgress(): profile.tsx:472 (delete account) & :505 (Reset Journey - runtime verified), login.tsx:288 (delete-account path) & :491 (Account-Not-Found 'Start Fresh'). Reset Journey runtime-verified to land on splash step 1.
login.tsx:358-369 adds an explicit back control (aria-label 'Go back') resolving the iOS dead-end design issue flagged in iteration_6.

Known limitation (by design, confirmed in A3): module-level progress in src/onboarding-progress.ts resets on web reload / native app kill, so mid-onboarding resume does not survive a full reload. Matches the review request's expected behavior.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only request; POST /api/auth/otp/send and /api/auth/otp/verify exercised via UI and worked)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral Playwright profiles only (localStorage wiped per run). Side effect on shared test account: delivered@resend.dev was logged in via OTP override and 'Reset Journey' was confirmed, which wiped that account's local + backend manifestation data (POST /api/account/reset) and reset its display name to 'Beautiful Soul' - expected product behavior; re-run onboarding or re-seed if the account is needed with data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both onboarding back-button bugs are fixed and verified: /login back (iteration_6) and /subscription auth-gate back (this iteration). Auth gate: email placeholder 'you@example.com', CTA 'Continue with Email', OTP stage title 'Check Your Email', OTP input placeholder '...' maxLength=4 (codes are 4 digits - use a 4-digit override code in mongo code_hash). Gate back arrow at ~(42,66), onboarding/referral back arrow at ~(42,30) in 375x667. Profile tab is the person icon at ~(305,612); direct URL /(tabs)/profile redirects to / on web but in-app tab navigation lands on /profile. Custom tab bar renders Pressables, NOT <a> anchors. Reset Journey confirm modal button text is 'Reset' (exact). OTP override: code_hash = sha256(f'{email}:{code}:{JWT_SECRET}') on db.otps; UI 'Sign In' re-sends the OTP so run a 1s-interval mongo poller during the login window.
rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG (user 2nd report): after completing onboarding, router.replace('/subscription') showed the unauthenticated AuthGateStep; its back button called router.back() which popped past the replaced /onboarding route to index, whose redirect effectively restarted onboarding at page 1. FIX (verified): onboarding completion now sets module-level lastOnboardingScreen=25 and navigates with params {from:'onboarding'} (onboarding.tsx:696-697); the gate's back handler routes from==='onboarding' to router.replace('/onboarding') (subscription.tsx:572), which mounts at screen 25 (paywall) via useState(getLastOnboardingScreen()) (onboarding.tsx:551). Genuine fresh starts (Reset Journey, delete account, login Account-Not-Found 'Start Fresh') call resetOnboardingProgress() so onboarding restarts at splash step 1. All six review-request scenarios verified passing at runtime.
